description: MNTN exact /sti tracking and conversion image requests, including documented product mapping and optional analytics context. Checks populated product price and image URL while accepting the sample producer null sentinels. Non-revenue conversions still allow omitted amount and order identity; custom metadata remains open.

params.name: shaid
params.description: The documented advertiser identity is required. It is usually numeric, so no numeric-only grammar is imposed.

params.name: cb
params.description: A nonempty cache-buster is required. The documentation permits arbitrary unique values.

params.name: conv
params.description: The published conversion example uses 1. Zero is accepted as a page-view flag.

params.name: plh
params.description: Optional absolute page URL, including iframe context.

params.name: shoid
params.description: Order or acquisition identity. The manual guide permits unmapped non-revenue conversions.

params.name: shoamt
params.description: A populated acquisition amount is numeric. The manual guide permits omission for non-revenue conversions.

params.name: shadditional
params.description: The image guide describes comma-separated key=value pairs. Custom names and values remain open.

params.name: shpn
params.description: Optional mapped product name. The sample can stringify null.

params.name: shpp
params.description: Optional mapped product price or the sample null sentinel.

params.name: shps
params.description: Mapped SKU remains opaque caller data.

params.name: shpi
params.description: Optional mapped product image URL; the sample can stringify null.

params.name: shpt
params.description: Optional page title from the published analytics snippet.

params.name: ga_tracking_id
params.description: Optional analytics identities may be a semicolon-separated list.

params.name: ga_client_id
params.description: Optional analytics client identity remains opaque.
